description: Defines the class DateRangeFieldItemList extending DateTimeFieldItemList, implementing form handling and default value processing for a date range field in Drupal.

classes.name: DateRangeFieldItemList
classes.description: A class extending DateTimeFieldItemList to handle date range default values and form interactions.

methods.name: defaultValuesForm
methods.description: Builds the form for default start and end date values, including options for current date or relative date.

methods.name: defaultValuesFormValidate
methods.description: Validates the relative date inputs using strtotime.

methods.name: defaultValuesFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, setting default values based on user input.

methods.name: processDefaultValue
methods.description: Processes and formats default date values for storage, supporting start and end date defaults.
